rationale: First Moirai-2.0 (multi-token 9-quantile head, decoder-only) claude shot produced the first alive W1 thr=0.4 sweep among recent attempts (+84.8% ann; WR 40.9% just 9pp shy of the 50% regime-WR floor) and a viable W3 thr=0.0 ann=-2.4% (vs the W3 0/20 wall most TS-FMs collapse to deep negatives on). avg_ann -1.4% beats both baselines (random_topk -30%, rule_only -28%). Train mode should sweep channel_indices ∈ {[0,1,24], [0,1,3,4,24], [0,1,3,4,10,11,24]} (per mantis-channel-pruning lesson — likely lifts W2/W3/W5 WR floor by dropping noisy xranks), pos_weight ∈ [1.0, 1.5] (lower to demote score-collapse), dropout ∈ [0.05, 0.30], head_hidden ∈ {64, 128, 256}, around pinned (ctx=512, pred=64) — per toto2-horizon96-regresses do NOT sweep encoder geometry jointly with head HPs.
